title: CircuitJEPA: a fully circuit-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for quantum dynamics
description:
CircuitJEPA is a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) whose three parametrized components (encoder, exponential-moving-average target encoder and horizon-conditioned predictor) are parametrized quantum circuits. Training is done in exact simulation with classical optimization on states of a 3-qubit transverse-field Ising chain; the trained circuits are evaluated on shot-based simulators and on the IBM Heron QPU ibm_marrakesh, where a pre-registered retrieval criterion was met for the designated seed.

This record archives the code, all results (training runs, simulator and QPU evaluations with raw counts, figures) and the paper (paper/circuitjepa.pdf). It is a feasibility study on 5 qubits, with no claim of quantum advantage or scalability.
